text:
emily: Quick sync  i've sketched a migration checklist for v1->v2 examples and webhook payloads. putting up a WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1112 :mag_right:
dan: nice. can you call out the webhook event shape change? support flagged a live integration that still posts `model_id` and `output` (singular).
emily: yep. checklist includes: (1) sweep curl examples for Authorization header and correct endpoint /v2/responses; (2) replace models.invoke usage with responses.create/stream patterns; (3) webhook payloads: model_id->model, output->outputs (array), timestamp format iso8601; (4) add tiny compat shim examples where safe; (5) add migration-checklist.md in docs/developer/ with anchors for quick scanning.
maria: add a note about embedding alias rename (embed-legacy-512 -> rwd-embed-512-v2) and link to assets/alias_map_v2.json. that caused a support escalator last week.
chris: also include a one-line explanation for why responses.create consolidates: unified schema + predictable streaming. a short collapsible "why we changed" helps reduce questions.
jen: docs-ci-bot complained about an examples lint earlier. docs-ci-bot: [ci] example-lint failed on examples/quickstart.md: used `X-Old-Auth` header and `models.invoke`.
emily: thanks bot  i'll include the failing CI note in the PR description and add a section "CI failures to watch" with common lint errors.
dan: practical ask: can we keep the curl examples minimal and add a link to full examples repo? customers often copy the one-liner. minimal = auth header + content-type + endpoint.
emily: agreed. sample replacements i'll add to PR: 
```bash
# OLD (v1)
curl -H "X-Old-Auth: $KEY" -d '{"model":"gpt-3.5","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/invoke
# NEW (v2 canonical)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses
```
and a two-line stream hint recommending SDK stream helpers for proper chunk framing.
maria: also remember function -> tool rename note. users keep asking about tools vs functions in tool-calling examples. short paragraph in migration-checklist.md.
chris: small edge-case: some legacy SDK snippets assume `response.output_text` field. v2 responses can be structured (outputs array). add an example to show `if outputs: join text else: fallback to output_text` style. keeps migrations robust.
emily: good call. i'll add a tiny polyfill snippet in python and js.
jen: CI status: docs-ci-bot: [ci] PR 1112 queued; examples job in ~10m. also flag: notebook-lint checks might fail if we change helper names in quickstarts. test accordingly.
dan: who will own the final merge? can we gate on two approvals and green examples CI?
emily: i can own merge. gating: 1) docs + dx review (chris, maria), 2) examples CI green, 3) changelog entry with deprecation blurb.
maria: i'll review the embed wording and the migration-checklist layout. also please include a short deprecation blurb text we can reuse in emails: "Docs examples are now canonical v2 patterns; v1 shim supported until 2025-12-31."
emily: draft note added to PR description. also adding a small changelog bullet under docs/changelog/2026-03-23.md.
chris: quick nit: for Go snippet, prefer idiomatic context usage and return error handling in the example. i'll add a quick commit if you want.
emily: please do. thanks.
docs-ci-bot: [ci] examples job started for PR 1112. ETA ~12m.
emily: ok everyone, action items: (A) Emily: finish PR with checklist + polyfills + changelog blurb; (B) Dan: sweep any team OWNED repos for lingering --model-id flags and notify maintainers; (C) Maria: review embed alias wording and migration callout; (D) Chris: tidy Go snippet + review. merge after 2 approvals + CI green.
jen: pinging reviewers: @chris @maria please review when you have a min.
emily: thanks all  i'll update thread when CI completes. :crossed_fingers:
